title: Qualify PR5285's h8 family closure with exact coverage
body:
PR5285's recorded search does not by itself establish its whole-family closure. An independent stdlib checker reconstructs all 17,478 admissible puncture sets and finds 43,122 represented set/receiver pairs out of 344,019,474 (343,976,352 absent). It reproduces 6,000 sampling draws, supplies an omitted allowed input, and identifies Stage C's saved effort 50 versus documented/spot-replay effort 2000.

New relative to Matarener's PR5285: source-derived domain enumeration, deduplicated coverage certificate, and a precise scope/provenance correction. Original census files and selected result are unchanged.

No new κ. This identifies a missing exclusion/equivalence argument, not a better word or a counterexample to optimality. No omitted word was built/priced; producer, transfer, compiler and outer proofs were not replayed. The historical Stage C invocation remains unresolved; inherited framework assumptions remain.

Base: 13be6ac685845c1ff671f5d26e7166165abd998e.
PR5285 source head: 440550b43428ef856ce217ec682111ba65ac93dc. Exact Git/SHA256 pins, scope, local seed-95 claim and supporting detail are in the package.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, no third-party dependencies):
`python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h8-census-coverage`
Expected: PASS_H8_CENSUS_COVERAGE, represented=43122, unrepresented=343976352; 16 tests; PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed: normal/-O replay, metadata/source-history checks, Git-free export with empty PATH and unchanged hashes, and 15 rejecting controls (including forged full-coverage/effort receipts and source-byte corruption). Hosted CI was not run.

Published commit: 3ce75dcac77004beff6ece24076636462fa991c6. Its complete tree 1507411197bd009db71622658357e98a236a7749 matches the tested tree, checked by GitHub objects and a fresh Git fetch/full-tree diff. No upstream PR submitted.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit Mark/Matarener's PR5285, eumemic's PR555/PR543/PR493 geometry and generator, DreamingOfClouds' PR589, and the retained lineage. Apache-2.0.
